name: Cadet officer shoulder board, right shoulder, top-down view (blank grade; rank_slot is the grade area)
size_basis: Redrawn to the CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-6 proportions: 2.3 in wide (just over the 2 1/4 in three-diamond row), 4.55 in long (builder reference), 0.74 in peak, emblem and stripe colours from the Vanguard CAP0647V photo measurements; follows the figure over the photo.

rank_slot_frame.runs: across the board (perpendicular to its length)
rank_slot_frame.note: the row of grade forms (Cadet Colonel: 3 diamonds 2 1/4 x 1 1/4 in) is centred on the blue band, CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-6; the board is 2.3 in wide so every grade fits at true size

landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in); rank_slot is the stripe band at the outer end, below the emblem
documented: cadet officers wear regular-size grade insignia on Cadet Officer shoulder boards (CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2.1.3 / 4.1.9.3.4)
assumed: stripe band centre 0.935 in from the outer end (from the board photo), grade slot 1.25 in along the board
